purpose: Review the completed 25 June 2026 EU economic-sanctions renewal as the first Analysis SANCTIONS_PROCESS specimen, separating pre-adoption political agreement, binding legal adoption, the in-force legal horizon, later sanctions calibration and the future renewal boundary without manufacturing surprise, market response or causality.

selection_rationale: Adds the first reviewed SANCTIONS_PROCESS and first TRADE_SANCTIONS_INDUSTRIAL_POLICY Analysis specimen.
Tests political agreement versus binding legal adoption: EU leaders publicly agreed the twelve-month extension before the Council adopted the binding act.
Tests institutional novelty versus surprise: a first full-year renewal after six-month rollovers is notable but was pre-signalled before formal adoption.
Tests legal adoption versus future expiry/renewal boundary: 25 June 2026 and 31 July 2027 are distinct canonical objects.
Tests legal continuity versus policy-content freeze: the later 21st sanctions package changed the regime within the annual horizon.
Tests contemporaneous-market contamination: large oil moves around the date had strong Iran/Strait of Hormuz drivers and are not promoted to an EU-renewal response.
Fresh Council, EUR-Lex, European Council and Reuters evidence supports the analysis without upstream canonical mutation.
selection.hold_rationale: Japan household spending remains a legitimate future macro specimen. AQ selects sanctions/legal-continuity object diversity, not queue exhaustion. The CORPORATE_FINANCIAL_MARKET_STRUCTURE completed-anchor gap also remains real but is not auto-filled by a mechanical historical expiry.

schema_decision.reason: Analysis v0.4 already represents NOT_ESTABLISHED surprise, OTHER_DEFENSIBLE_EXPECTATION benchmarks, empty market response, LEGAL_OR_OPERATIONAL_DEPENDENCY, NOT_A_CAUSAL_CLAIM, PLAUSIBLE_WATCH_ITEM second-order effects, alternatives and falsifiers. The challenge is stage and causality discipline rather than missing schema capacity.

descendant_checkpoint_repair.live_descendant_change: Permit reviewed count >=18, event-type diversity >=16, Analysis review/evidence versions >=0.14 and evidence count >=79, while retaining exactly one HEALTH_GOVERNANCE_EVENT contribution and leaving AP plan/payload/exact transform frozen.
descendant_checkpoint_repair.reason: AP remains historically exact at its own post-state, but its live descendant assertions must permit legitimate AQ Analysis growth.
